description: Scammer impersonates SBI warning of immediate account freeze, leading to credential and OTP phishing portal.

events.description: SMS: SBI Alert: Your netbanking is blocked due to pending KYC. Update now at https://sbi-verify.example.test/kyc
Phishing portal prompts for netbanking username and password
Portal prompts user to enter 6-digit one-time password
Deceptive authorization for INR 25,000 to fraudster.wallet@fakeupi
Victim on payment approval confirmation step

evidence.observation: Sender claims to represent State Bank of India netbanking security
Account suspension threat tied to financial banking access
Domain sbi-verify.example.test mimics official brand on newly created host
DOM contains sensitive OTP input field under unverified origin
Target VPA fraudster.wallet@fakeupi belongs to an unverified private individual
